cards.title: Fixed: bosses dying early
cards.text: In 0.21.0, breaking a boss part killed the whole boss. Fixed in 0.21.1, and two bosses evened out.
cards.why: If you played 0.21.0, the Great Engine, Cinder, the Ooze, the angel and the Sand Wurm could die the moment a hand, plate or segment broke.
cards.details:
Cause: the Mob's four bodies point at their leader, and boss parts point at their boss the same way, so the new Mob code treated every boss part as a Mob body. Found by the lane that re-measured the bosses.

With the fix the bosses were re-measured at the level a fresh campaign now meets them (the XP change moved those). Two were far too hard and are eased to about even: the Great Engine's health 680 to 580 (20 wins in 40), the Sand Wurm's breach hits softer (20 wins in 40; it was 6).

Not changed yet, waiting on your boss answers: the Elder Ent and the Bone King win too easily (33 and 37 of 40), the Great Ooze is a bit hard (13 of 40).

cards.title: Eight statuses in the Book
cards.text: Whirled, Spun, Dirty, Targeted, Tracked, Trapped, Warded and Weakened are real statuses, each in the Book.
cards.why: They were each hero's own effect before, with no Book entry or status mark. They work exactly as before: measured, same runs with the same seeds.
cards.details: Also found and fixed on the way: the Engineer's snowball mortar was firing Foundry shells (an enemy of the same name overwrote it), and the Warden's Nullify stripped a Warded hero's border but left the shield on. The Book's old generic 'Weakened' tile is now 'Hindered', so two tiles don't share a name.
